about: The review of each map's exact bytes (docs/decisions/0017-a-map-change-carries-a-review-of-its-bytes.md). tools/check-map-review.py fails any map whose sha256 is not the one recorded here.

corpus-map.json.note: Issue #106, step 3. compare.py read the map at 5216c62 (86 entries), the bytes the legacy exemption covered, and exits 1 unless each of its 259 flags has a row in resolutions.json. The map was corrected to those rows (21 blind-right, 11 corpus-does-not-settle; 91 entries) in the same commit that replaced the exemption with this review. sha256 is the corrected map; compared.sha256 is the map before correction. The blind mapper worked from docs with the SRD's name, combat vocabulary and the backgammon examples removed (blind-mapping/REDACTIONS.md), and from the corpus text and renders of pp. 13-16; what could not be ruled out, including that the mapper model knows this game, is in blind-mapping/README.md, Limits.
